issues.description: Tested-by linker produced incorrect edge directionality: 7 tested_by edges point FROM test files (test/nfs/*) TO a test file (test/test/JUnitTest.java), and the source test files were tagged 'tested' instead of identifying actual production code under test.
issues.recommendation: Fix tested-by linker logic to correctly identify production→test relationships based on path conventions (src/ vs test/)

issues.description: 4 configures edges dropped during merge because target virtual config nodes don't exist as file nodes: config:dist/testNET.jar, config:src, config:test. These are build-system virtual paths referenced in NetBeans config but not actual files.

warnings.affected_batches: batch-3 (packages tests), batch-4 (Lance driver core), batch-5 (NFS/RPC tests)

warnings.description: Only 5 config nodes exist (build.xml, nbproject/*), but scan-result shows manifest.mf as 'code' category. Assembled graph correctly has it as file:manifest.mf (type file). This is consistent but worth noting for layer assignment.

suggestions.description: All 66 file-level nodes (5 config, 1 document, 60 file) are present and have filePath for layer assignment. Recommend layer mapping: config/* → build, src/jx/net/* → network, src/org/jnode/driver/net/lance/* → driver, src/jx/netmanager/* → netmanager, src/org/jnode/net/ipv4/dhcp/* → dhcp, src/test/* → test-integration, test/* → test-unit, packages/test_* → test-packages

Cross-batch imports (3 edges) are accurate per import map: LanceFinder.java imports LanceDriver.java and LanceFlags.java; NetInit.java imports DHCPClient.java. No missing or spurious import edges detected.

Graph is structurally sound: 387 unique nodes (no duplicate IDs), 728 unique edges (no duplicate edges), all edge sources/targets reference existing nodes. Contains/containment hierarchy is complete for all file→class→function chains.

summary: Assembled graph (387 nodes, 728 edges) is structurally valid with complete file coverage (66/66 source files), all required node fields present, and all edges referencing valid nodes. Cross-batch imports are correct. Main quality issues: missing languageNotes on ~200 nodes from later batches, incorrect tested-by edge directionality (test→test instead of production→test), and minimal summaries on auto-extracted nodes. 4 config edges dropped due to missing virtual config targets (expected). Graph ready for layer assignment with minor data quality fixes recommended.
